get.summary: The account's campaigns, of one of its systems when system is given, newest first, each with its system; the archived ones only with archived=true, else the others. request.not_found (404) for a system that is not the account's (unknown, another account's or malformed); request.invalid (400) for an archived other than true or false, a limit outside 1 to 50 or a malformed cursor; session.required (401) without a session.

post.summary: A new campaign of one of the account's systems (201), with the starting scope; it becomes the current campaign. request.campaign_name_invalid (400) for a name outside its limits (params min and max), request.campaign_name_taken (409) when the system has a campaign with the same name (trimmed, whatever the case; an archived campaign keeps its name), request.not_found (404) for a system that is not the account's (unknown, another account's, malformed or being deleted), request.invalid (400) without a systemId or for a malformed body; nothing is stored then; session.required (401) without a session.

get.summary: The current campaign with its system: of the account's campaigns that are not archived, the one chosen last (PUT), else the oldest; session.required (401) without a session, request.not_found (404) when the account has no such campaign

put.summary: Makes one of the account's campaigns the current one and answers it; its version does not change. request.not_found (404) for an archived campaign or any other id (unknown, another account's or malformed), request.invalid (400) without a campaignId or for a malformed body; nothing changes then; session.required (401) without a session.

get.summary: The campaign's conversation (a campaign has at most one) and how many questions it holds, for an archived campaign too; request.not_found (404) when the campaign has none or is not the account's (unknown, another account's or malformed)

post.summary: Ask a question in the campaign's conversation: the turn and its answer job are recorded together (201); request.invalid (400) for a blank question or one past 4,000 code points, request.not_found (404) for a campaign that is not the account's; nothing is recorded then

delete.summary: Deletes one of the account's campaigns, archived, current or last (202, no body): from now on it is not found, the current campaign falls back to another (or there is none), its name is free in its system, and its conversation and the materials attached to it are removed in the background; nothing of its system or of the other campaigns changes. Cannot be undone. request.not_found (404) for any other id, a campaign already being deleted included; session.required (401) without a session.

get.summary: One of the account's campaigns, with its system, archived or not; request.not_found (404) for any other id

patch.summary: Renames, archives or restores one of the account's campaigns on the version it names: the campaign as stored, its version raised by one. An archived campaign leaves the lists and the current position but keeps everything and still opens by id. request.stale_version (409) when the campaign has left that version, request.campaign_name_taken (409) when another campaign of its system has the new name (an archived campaign keeps its name), request.campaign_name_invalid (400) for a name outside its limits, request.invalid (400) without a version, with neither name nor archived, or for a malformed body, request.not_found (404) for any other id; nothing changes then; session.required (401) without a session.

get.summary: What goes with one of the account's campaigns if it is deleted: how many conversations and materials (those attached to it). request.not_found (404) for any other id, a campaign being deleted included; session.required (401) without a session.

The current campaign's conversation: its campaign, whether it has an accepted source, and how many of its passages are still being prepared for search (null when nothing is pending); request.not_found (404) when the account has no campaign

post.summary: An ordered set of images that become the pages of one material, its order confirmed: the material, its version in uploading and one tus upload per image, each expiring after 6 hours. The first ingestion step starts by itself once every image is complete. upload.set_too_large (413, params.maxImages and params.maxBytes) past 500 images or 2 GiB in all; upload.metadata_invalid (400) for a name (the set's or an image's) or a kind, language, campaign or system that is not valid, an empty list or more than 100 systems, or a campaign, system and systems given together (it never says which); request.invalid (400) for a body without images or an image without a size of at least 1 byte; request.unsupported_media_type (415) for a body that is not JSON; session.required (401) without a session.

200.description: The set as it is now

delete.summary: Leaves out the failed image at a place of a set still uploading: the images after it move up by one place, and the set starts when every image left is complete; leaving out the last one discards the version. upload.image_not_failed (409) when the image there has not failed; request.not_found (404) for another account's set, an unknown one, a set no longer uploading or a place it does not have; session.required (401) without a session.

post.summary: Replaces the failed image at a place of a set still uploading: a new tus upload at that place, checked again, expiring after 6 hours. upload.image_not_failed (409) when the image there has not failed; upload.set_too_large (413, params.maxImages and params.maxBytes) past 500 images or 2 GiB in all; upload.metadata_invalid (400) for a name that is not valid; request.invalid (400) for a size under 1 byte; request.not_found (404) for another account's set, an unknown one, a set no longer uploading or a place it does not have; session.required (401) without a session.

A material whose every place is being deleted is left out, so a page may hold fewer than the limit. request.invalid (400) for an unknown state, a limit outside 1 to 50 or a malformed cursor; request.not_found (404) for a system that is not the account's (unknown, another account's or malformed); session.required (401) without a session.

Takes no body and answers the material. material.action_unavailable (409) when the newest version's state does not allow it now (see the material's actions); request.not_found (404) for another owner's material or an unknown or malformed id, and nothing changes; session.required (401) without a session.

Discards the newest version of one of the account's materials, which needs review or failed: it becomes discarded, and its pages, passages, outline and files are removed (a removal that resumes after a restart). The quality report of one of the account's materials: its newest version's outline, unreadable pages and warnings, while that version needs review or is ready (the counts are the material's pages). request.not_found (404) for another owner's material, an unknown or malformed id, or a version in any other state; session.required (401) without a session.

Takes no body and answers the material. material.action_unavailable (409) when the newest version's state does not allow it now (see the material's actions); request.not_found (404) for another owner's material or an unknown or malformed id, and nothing changes; session.required (401) without a session.

Starts again the failed newest version of one of the account's materials, from its cleaned original or its uploaded file: it becomes processing. ingestion.too_many_steps (409) when a new step would pass the version's step cap. Takes no body and answers the material. material.action_unavailable (409) when the newest version's state does not allow it now (see the material's actions); request.not_found (404) for another owner's material or an unknown or malformed id, and nothing changes; session.required (401) without a session.

get.summary: The turn's answer as server-sent events: the stored events after Last-Event-ID (0 when absent), then new ones as they are written. Events: delta (TurnDeltaEvent), citation (TurnCitationEvent), done (TurnDoneEvent) and error (TurnErrorEvent), each with id: its sequence (1, 2, ... per turn). A comment line ': keep-alive' every 15 s; the stream closes after done or error, and after 30 minutes without either: the client then reopens it with Last-Event-ID, the id of the last event it received. Leaving never touches the answer. request.not_found (404) for a turn that is not the account's

One page of the version a turn's source reference names: its picture size and text lines (a PDF page) or its text (a text page), and its passages' places, the same shape as MaterialPageView; an unreadable page with no view has picture null and outcome unreadable. The ground is the path: a source reference stored with a turn of the account's campaign (AD-9). The page is read from the version the reference names, even when a newer one was accepted since; any page from 1 to its page total. request.not_found (404) for a turn that is not the account's, a malformed or unknown id or number, no such reference, a version removed since, a page outside 1 to the page total, or a page with no view (unless it is unreadable)

The picture of one page of the version a turn's source reference names, as WebP, streamed. request.not_found (404) also for a page with no picture (a text page, or an unreadable page with no view). The ground is the path: a source reference stored with a turn of the account's campaign (AD-9). The page is read from the version the reference names, even when a newer one was accepted since; any page from 1 to its page total. request.not_found (404) for a turn that is not the account's, a malformed or unknown id or number, no such reference, a version removed since, a page outside 1 to the page total, or a page with no view (unless it is unreadable)

post.summary: Stop the turn's answer (204): its stream ends at once with a done event marked stopped, after the text and citations stored so far, and the worker is told to stop at its next batch. A turn whose answer has ended already is left as it is (204 too), so repeating it is safe. request.not_found (404) for a turn that is not the account's

patch.summary: tus 1.0.0 part, at most 90 MiB, with its SHA-256. The first part decides the format from content: upload.format_refused (415, params.accepted) leaves nothing behind. upload.part_checksum_mismatch (460) and a cut body leave the offset unchanged; upload.offset_conflict (409) when Upload-Offset is not the stored offset; upload.busy (423) while another part is written; upload.too_large (413) over 90 MiB or past Upload-Length; upload.expired (410) after 6 hours; request.invalid (400) for a missing or malformed Upload-Offset or Upload-Checksum, a cut body or a first part shorter than its first 4 KiB (or the whole file); request.unsupported_media_type (415) for a body that is not application/offset+octet-stream; request.not_found (404) for any other id; upload.tus_version (412) without Tus-Resumable: 1.0.0; session.required (401) without a session.

post.summary: Checks the whole file's SHA-256 once every byte is stored: the version becomes waiting. upload.incomplete (409) before the last byte; upload.file_checksum_mismatch (422) discards the version and its pieces; upload.busy (423) while a part is written; upload.expired (410) after 6 hours; request.invalid (400) for a body without a 64-hex sha256; request.unsupported_media_type (415) for a body that is not JSON; request.not_found (404) for any other id; upload.tus_version (412) without Tus-Resumable: 1.0.0; session.required (401) without a session.
